reviews.text: Excellent clinic!! Luna Maria, Mancha, and Bina love the care from the best veterinarian in the world, the wonderful Dr. Juliana Lima!!!!

My family and I have been caring for our Shih Tzu, Tobias, for almost 5 years and we love the service. The clinic is super ethical, respectful, and professional. We felt safe. The professionals are excellent. We just left. Tobias was seen by Dr. Lara. Absolutely wonderful.

My experience with VetService has been very good.
From reception to medical care
My cat Cinza was hospitalized in a coma and he is being treated very well.
He is recovering, thanks to the speed, attention and skill of the veterinarians.
Especially Dr. Carolina who provided the initial care.
But I thank all the on-call veterinarians.

Thank you very much.
It was great, I loved the service with Dr. Lizandra, my Boris thanks you too, I'm speechless, I don't know how to thank her for the care she has for the little angels ❤️❤️🤗 …

I have 5 cats, we've been to other clinics before, and the difference in treatment is noticeable. We love the clinic! All the Vet Service staff, regardless of their role, have always been very polite and helpful. Congratulations to each and every one of you! Special thanks to Dr. Lara for all her attention, dedication, and professionalism. I always recommend them.
So far I have nothing to complain about, my daughter uses physiotherapy and I love Dr. Carolina, a very dedicated professional.

It's only worth it if your pet has something very simple, like a stomach ache or a fever that isn't serious. Because if you go expecting a real clinic with loving professionals, you'll be sorely disappointed. They try to sell you a false sense of kindness, but the falseness comes before the fake charisma they try to sell. And most importantly, they are terrible professionals. If you have another place to take your pets, take them there, because the regret later can be costly. I took my puppy there and they treated him with unparalleled disdain. I went straight to another place, a humane, decent place with real veterinarians!
Great place, they took very good care of my dog.

I've been taking my pets to Vet Service for a long time.
The service is excellent, and the professionals and staff are highly competent, without any exaggeration.
Special mention to Dr. Vanessa, staff member Priscila, and receptionist Camila.

I recommend them.
Excellent clinic. Great professionals, excellent facilities. Dr. Lara has been taking care of my dogs for many years; she is always attentive, careful, loving, and humane.
Best veterinarian ever!! Congratulations on the service.
The clinic has a good structure and new equipment.
Excellent facilities, super polite staff, and great professionals!

I haven't encountered professionals in a long time who demonstrate so much care and dedication to the work they do, from the reception staff to the veterinarians. The way the entire team conveys zeal and care for our beloved pets makes the service welcoming and gives us confidence and peace of mind.
The word "exceptional" is still not enough to describe the experience I had with Vet Service. I would especially like to highlight veterinarian Lizandra, who, on every occasion I needed to take my cats, was always willing to offer the best service, demonstrating attention, empathy, and commitment. She is an example of a professional who practices her profession with competence and humanity.
I leave here my recognition and gratitude to the entire team for the excellent work. It is admirable to find people who treat our animals with so much respect and affection, also welcoming the owners at this very important moment.
Excellent clinic, with wonderful service, everything very clean and, most importantly, fair prices…
Excellent. My cat was treated by Dr. Igor at OdontoVet, I highly recommend him.

Our pet entered this clinic alive and, unfortunately, was delivered to us dead. He already had a significant drop in insulin levels, and even so, he was left in the care of a veterinarian who, we were told, was still new to inpatient care.

At the time of admission, we were assured that all care would be monitored and supervised by a responsible veterinarian. However, given everything that happened, this supervision, in practice, does not seem to have occurred as we were informed.

We are devastated and feel that our pet did not receive the care and supervision we expected at such a delicate time. We are left with many unanswered questions and immense pain over the loss of our pet.

My experience with Vet Service was marked by much pain, suffering, and disappointment.

We spent over R$ 20,000 on surgeries, hospitalizations, and procedures trying to save our Spock, who was like family to us.

I want to acknowledge Dr. Mariana, the only professional from whom I truly felt affection and humanity towards him. I am grateful for the caring way she communicated his passing, for the reduction in the daily rate from R$ 370 to R$ 314, and for some discounts granted.

Unfortunately, my experience with other professionals was very different.

During a hospitalization, I went to visit Spock and I opened his mouth myself. I noticed that the mucous membrane was pale and immediately informed the responsible veterinarian. She replied: “No, it isn’t. I just looked and it was normal.”

It wasn’t. Shortly after, Spock urgently needed a blood transfusion.

I am not a veterinarian, I am a pet owner. We were paying for his hospitalization precisely so that he could be under observation and care. It was very distressing to notice, during a simple visit, a change that soon proved to be serious.

On another occasion, while they were trying to insert a catheter through his urethra, Spock screamed in pain, and I witnessed professionals laughing during the procedure. That shocked me deeply.

Feeling that he wasn't receiving the attention he needed, I decided to take him home when he was discharged. It was at home that he developed sepsis. When I realized the condition was worsening, I asked several times for them to be honest with me. If he was in his final moments, I wanted to take him home and allow him to pass away with his family.

According to the veterinarian who was following the case, the situation was serious, but he was doing well. In one conversation, she even said, laughing: "Right, Spock? You're not going to swim, swim and..."

Well, yes. He swam, swam... and died in your hands.

Perhaps nothing could have changed the outcome. But I wanted to have had the right to decide how his last moments would be: to take him home, hold him, and tell him he was loved.

After his death, when I went to the clinic to see my son's little body, the veterinarian who participated in both surgeries and followed the case didn't come to speak with us. The justification was that she was performing surgery. I can understand that, but the message of "my condolences" only arrived at 9 pm, saying that she was waiting for the results of an exam before speaking with us. Three days later, a letter arrived that, to me, seemed impersonal.

What struck me most was the difference in attitude: to talk about money, there was availability a few minutes later. To talk about the death of our cat and offer a word of comfort after everything we went through, there was none.

It was three months of worry, fear, hope, hospitalizations, surgeries, and suffering. We did everything for Spock, and I leave with a clear conscience.

Perhaps for the clinic he was just another patient. For us, he was our family. To my Spock, all my love and the certainty that he was loved until the very last second.

To Vet Service, I offer my disappointment and what I learned.

Until we meet again.

It was three months of worry, fear, hope, hospitalizations, surgeries, and suffering. We did everything for Spock, and I leave with a clear conscience.

Perhaps for the clinic he was just another patient. For us, he was our family. I could recount every absurd thing that happened during that time, but nothing will bring Spock back.

To my Spock, all my love and the certainty that he was loved until the very last second.

To Vet Service, I leave my disappointment and my learning experience.

Goodbye forever.
Posting this so my future self remembers never to come to this place. They gave my dog ​​the wrong injection and then charged 800 reais to remove the thorns when other clinics did it for 200.

I was at the clinic today with my kitten and was seen by Dr. Maria Eduarda Paz. Excellent service. She explained each procedure in detail and was super caring with my kitten.
Exceptional service.
I went to the clinic at night with my kitten for emergency care. We were very well attended to by Dr. Dandara, the on-call doctor. My kitten's problem was resolved promptly.
I loved the service, the place, everything was perfect. They did so much for my dog. I still go there and recommend it. 💜 …
I would like to congratulate the managers and professionals of this clinic, especially Dr. Marcos (ophthalmologist), who took great care in examining my daughter Mel. I was very satisfied.

We were already familiar with the clinic and trusted the qualifications of its professionals, but Dr. Lizandra's service exceeded our expectations. I am extremely grateful for the empathy, care, and affection she has shown us in recent days.
I am familiar with their services and highly recommend them. Excellent service, 10 out of 10.
Excellent clinic, with the facilities to safely care for our animals. I recommend Vet Service without hesitation!

I have immense affection for the clinic, both for my professional experiences there and for the care they provide for my pets ❤️. My puppy Café was just neutered and received all the support he needed at every stage! And, just like him, my other two pets have always been very well cared for. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for the care, attention, and for all the family/friends that Vet Service has given me!
Welcoming and with excellent professionals.

From the bottom of my heart, I thank God for these people appearing in my life. The young man I spoke to on WhatsApp (Rafael) who initiated the contact. And the Angel of God on earth, guided by Saint Lazarus, who is Dr. Lizandra, who is HUMANE, her calm voice reassures the tutor. I thank the other doctor who was also on the line, along with Dr. Lizandra. I THANK EVERYONE AT VETSERVICE. For so much excellence, empathy and care in the service. I love you all!! Lizandra, your gift is very cute! A kiss

It wasn't good. They don't have a CT scan, they don't have cardiology, they don't have ultrasound. They have nothing. All the exams have to come from freelance doctors. The clinic doesn't have emergency equipment. If you need an emergency echocardiogram, you're screwed. Your pet will die.
You arrive at the emergency room, there are no pets waiting to be seen, and it takes more than an hour to be called. This is the second time it's happened. I'm not going back!

I've been taking my cats to this clinic for almost 5 years and I have nothing but praise! From Pri and Nay, who work at reception, to all the vets and technicians! The environment is clean and organized, the professionals are super attentive and always adapt to the pets' needs! I've had to hospitalize my cats before, and the attention to detail in the interaction, sending photos, visits, updates, etc., I always recommend them without hesitation! I must highlight the EXCELLENT service from Lara, Vanessa, Lizandra, Maite, and Kelly, who have always taken great care of my little ones!

From the reception to the veterinary care, there was so much affection and attention.

The clinic is large and comfortable, with impeccable hygiene!! I highly recommend it!
Excellent clinic, clean environment, and with excellent professionals who are very polite, attentive, and communicative.

Traumatic experience on April 9th, 2025!

My dog ​​needed eye surgery, and we rushed to get an EKG and blood tests done. Because of the evaluation and "speed," we went to Vet Service, but the experience was terrible.

Our dog was wearing a collar and had one eye closed due to an ingrown eyelash, which already made the situation complicated. To do the EKG, the vet didn't call an assistant; she asked my girlfriend and me to hold her (perhaps she didn't see the need for someone trained because it was a Pug). However, as expected, we aren't specialists in this, which made the situation even more stressful—two laypeople having to hold the dog in a difficult position, without moving, for 3 minutes!!

Afterwards, she asked us to hold her again for the blood tests, keeping her paw still, even though my girlfriend said she was afraid of needles, and guess what? Of course she moved! We're not good at this kind of thing!! In total there were 3 attempts (on the first one my dog's vein BURST!), and she only called for help on the THIRD TIME, and who would have thought, it worked!! And all the stress was accompanied by jokes from the doctor to my dog ​​like "you're an adult now, you don't need to be nervous" 😬

Unfortunately, at the end of the next day we received the test results with the doctor saying that the blood clotted "due to stress" and we would have to collect it again!! Studies suggest that, in 60-70% of cases, blood clotting occurs due to human error, such as incorrect handling, delay in mixing with the anticoagulant, use of inadequate materials, among others. Honestly, my dog ​​was very stressed (and they contributed to that), but I can't accept that this was the only cause... We went back, and this time there was a helper from the beginning, and the collection was successful on the first try...

The next day the doctor informed us that the blood had clotted AGAIN, causing us even more stress and despair, and 20 minutes later, while we were thinking about what to do to get the surgery done, she sent a message saying she "saw it wrong," saw the same test, and then sent the test that had been successful!

In short, that was the experience. The positive reviews we've seen here don't even come close to what we went through. We encountered a lot of unpreparedness and a lack of basic procedures. I honestly don't recommend this place to anyone! If it happened to us, it can happen to you too.

We needed help for my dog ​​and we were greatly supported by the Vet Service team, from the receptionists to the nurses and doctors. The love and respect with which they carry out their activities is evident. I especially thank Dr. Pietra, Dr. Juliana, Dr. Brenda, Dr. Maithê, nurse Renan and the other one (excuse me, I forgot to ask his name), Nayara, Margarete, Kelly and everyone. If I forgot to mention someone, please forgive me.
The care wasn't just for my furry friend.
I recommend the company. It's made up of people who truly love animals and people.
Eternal gratitude to you all 🌹

Today is a sad day for me; my furry son has gone to God's arms. But I couldn't let this day pass without mentioning how important the care at Vet Vet Service was. Excellent service and great support. I arrived with the emergency my furry friend needed, and the highly prepared team knew how to manage his care. I can only thank them for the affection and care they gave my furry son. I know he was very well taken care of. If you feel lost in this world of fake veterinarians, know that here you have a wonderful team. I highly recommend their service.

I would like to thank all the staff at the clinic for their care and promptness, from reception to the doctor. Their humanism and willingness to save is impressive. In particular, Dr. Lara and Dr. Lizandra, who tried everything to save my little pet. Unfortunately, kidney disease is very complex, and my 10-year-old baby became a little star... but we tried everything, and that comforts me. Thank you Vet Service, you are wonderful!
I really liked the clinic and the professionals.

What a wonderful clinic!!! They have blood tests, X-rays, specialists, vaccines, surgery, etc. What a structure! What cleanliness! What organization! I asked why they didn't have a pharmacy or grooming services and they replied: "Do you buy medicine and get your hair cut at the hospital? Here the focus is on saving lives!" What a veterinary spirit!

Cleanliness 10, Service 10, Facilities and Equipment 10, Trustworthiness 10, Maintenance 10, Very fair price for what they offer! It's a world-class clinic, my cat had emergency surgery for a large cut on her paw and the treatment was VIP. I wish the private human hospitals in Rio de Janeiro were like Vet Service!

The best and most reliable clinic in the country! My cat was seen in the emergency room at 5 am and put on oxygen. During hospitalization they gave me a quote, but upon discharge, they reduced the price because they had estimated 3 hours of oxygen and she improved with only 1 hour. If they hadn't said that, I would have paid for all 3 hours! This kind of trust is priceless! And the clinic is incredibly well-equipped, super clean, and the care is truly focused on saving lives, not on financial gain! That's what practicing veterinary medicine is all about!!!!!
We received excellent care. Poppy, our 6-year-old dog, was admitted and received excellent treatment. The doctors and staff were super attentive.
Excellent experience. Very attentive.

We are receiving treatment for our dog from very competent and caring veterinarians, who are always very willing to assist with her treatment. Our thanks to Dr. Vanessa, Dr. Juliana who cared for her during her hospitalization, and the nephrologist Dr. Renata for all the care and dedication to our baby Kyra.

Excellent. I was very well received with my pets. They are attentive, the clinic is well-equipped and has fair prices. Everyone, without exception, is super attentive, starting with the reception.

An important differentiator today is that they provide 2 to 3 parking spaces inside the clinic.
They say it's a 24-hour clinic, but I went and spent ages ringing the intercom and nobody answered. I'm only not giving it 0 stars because it's not possible.

First experience, worst possible. Almost two hours of waiting without being seen. Only one veterinarian to attend to the waiting room and urgent cases. I saw a good review of the company here on Google, which led me to try the clinic: pure frustration and wasted time.
Dr. Lara is an exemplary professional and human being. Congratulations!

Wonderful service from the entire team. My pet was very well received and well cared for! Immense gratitude to all the vets who cared for and continue to care for him, especially Dr. Keli and Dr. Juliana. Their love for their profession and for animals is remarkable. Thank you!!!

The service is excellent! From the reception staff to consultations, exams, and everything else. The clinic is complete.
I arrived with my daughter, who was very ill with pyometra, and she was promptly …
Wonderful team, Dr. Vanessa is a sweetheart, attentive, and answered all my questions!

In the midst of the pandemic, a kitten I adopted, who wasn't yet spayed, had pyometra. She was already elderly when I adopted her, so it was a delicate surgery, and yet everything went wonderfully. Dr. Lara was very attentive. I highly recommend her!
